claims: "No Kings" protests took place across the U.S. on March 28, 2026.
The demonstrations opposed the Trump administration's immigration policies.
The demonstrations opposed the war in Iran.
The demonstrations opposed alleged authoritarian actions.
A major "flagship" rally took place in St. Paul, MN.
The "flagship" rally featured performances by Bruce Springsteen.
The main rally took place in St. Paul, Minnesota.
The main rally was prompted by the deaths of individuals involving immigration officers in the Twin Cities.
Over 3,200 marches and rallies were scheduled across all 50 states.
There were turnouts in Washington D.C., San Francisco, and Louisville, KY.
Immigration enforcement (ICE) was a key issue highlighted.
The war with Iran was a key issue highlighted.
The rising cost of living was a key issue highlighted.
The "No Kings" movement is organized by the "No Kings" coalition.
Based on search results, the "No Kings" protests are described as anti-Trump protests.
Based on search results, the "No Kings" protests are not "pro-king" rallies.
